ponca: A farm on a timbered hilltop above the Missouri River north of Omaha, Nebraska: a plain white two-story farmhouse with a deep front porch and an old red barn, a tall windmill, a long wire fence hung with dozens of old burlap and flour-sack sandbags drying in a row, a pile of sand beside the barn, oak and cottonwood woods falling away down the bluffs, the wide brown Missouri River and its floodplain far below. Full frame, edge to edge, no borders.
